newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers August same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers August same-store sales off.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Thursday its same-store sales fell 2.5 percent during August.
The retailer said total sales fell to $89.4 million in August, down 20.5 percent from $112.4 million during the same period a year ago.
Edison operated an average of 1,933 stores last month compared with 2,728 outlets a year earlier.
For the 30 weeks ended August 31, the company's same-store sales fell 3.6 percent. Total sales fell 20.1 percent to $616.4 million, the company said.
